name: kilter-money
description: Personal finance tracking for ChatGPT: log expenses and income, split receipts by category, review fixed bills, and check how your month and budgets are going.

interface.longDescription:
Kilter Money is a personal finance app for keeping track of where your money goes. Connect it to ask how your month is going, log an expense or a whole receipt, record income, check a budget, or see which fixed bills are coming up, all from a chat.

Everything comes from what you log in Kilter Money. It never connects to your bank, never moves money, and never sees your payment details. You sign in on Kilter Money's own page, choose what ChatGPT can read and change, and can disconnect it at any time.

What you can do:
- Get a summary of the month: income, spending by category, how much of your income goes to fixed bills, and whether you're on track compared with last month.
- Log expenses, including a store receipt split across categories in one entry.
- Log one-off income and set up recurring bills.
- See your fixed bills and what you owe on your credit cards.
- Create and adjust budgets and categories.
capabilities: See what you owe on your cards
defaultPrompt: How are my finances this month?
What fixed bills do I have this month?

positive.prompt: How are my finances this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the current month from the demo account: income, spending by category (Housing, Groceries, Transport, Dining, Entertainment), the share of income going to fixed bills, the Essentials, Lifestyle and Savings budgets, the on-track status and the change from last month. All numbers come from the tool result.
Finds the Dining category, logs one $12.40 expense dated today, and confirms the amount, date and category.

positive.prompt: What fixed bills do I have this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Rent ($1,800.00 on the 1st) and Internet ($70.00 on the 15th), both in Housing, with this month's dates.

positive.prompt: How is my Lifestyle budget doing this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the Lifestyle budget (20% of income, covering Dining and Entertainment): the amount allocated, the amount spent so far and the percentage used. It may call list_budgets to name the categories in it.

positive.prompt: How much do I owe on my credit cards?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the amount owed on the RBC Avion card and its next due date, and notes that it's based on what was logged in Kilter Money, not a bank balance.

negative.description: Investment advice is out of scope
negative.prompt: Should I move my savings into crypto or index funds?
Send $200 from my bank account to my landlord.
Write me a short poem about autumn.

publication.release_notes: First release as a plugin. Fixes sign-in for people who aren't already signed in to Kilter Money when they connect, and adds the receipt-splitting skill.

pt-BR.subtitle: Controle gastos e orçamentos
pt-BR.description:
O Kilter Money é um app de finanças pessoais para acompanhar para onde vai o seu dinheiro. Conecte para perguntar como está o seu mês, registrar um gasto ou um recibo inteiro, lançar uma receita, ver um orçamento ou conferir as contas fixas, tudo pelo chat.

Tudo vem do que você registra no Kilter Money. Ele nunca se conecta ao seu banco, nunca movimenta dinheiro e nunca vê seus dados de pagamento. Você entra pela página do próprio Kilter Money, escolhe o que o ChatGPT pode ler e alterar, e pode desconectar quando quiser.

O que você pode fazer:
- Ver o resumo do mês: receitas, gastos por categoria, quanto da renda vai para contas fixas e se você está no caminho certo em relação ao mês passado.
- Registrar gastos, inclusive um recibo de mercado dividido entre categorias em um único lançamento.
- Lançar receitas avulsas e cadastrar contas fixas.
- Ver suas contas fixas e quanto você deve nos cartões de crédito.
- Criar e ajustar orçamentos e categorias.
